info.title: Medical Courier Services API
info.description:
Complete API documentation for Medical Courier Services - Web Dashboard & Mobile Applications

**Two Separate API Systems:**

1. **Web/Admin API** (`/api/v1/`) - For dashboard and management
2. **Mobile API** (`/api/mobile/v1/`) - For driver mobile application

**New Features:**
- Pre-Duty Safety Checklist (4 categories: Vehicle, Etiquette, HIPAA Compliance, Medical Equipment)
- Job Request Management (Accept/Decline with reasons)
- Real-time GPS Tracking
- Digital Signature & Photo Capture
- Medical Item Type Support (Blood, Urine, Specimens, Equipment)
- Comprehensive Driver Statistics

**Features:**
- Dynamic pagination (configurable, max 100 per page)
- Role-based access control (admin, coordinator, driver)
- Laravel Sanctum token authentication
- HIPAA compliance verification
- Activity logging and audit trails

sanctum.description:
Laravel Sanctum Token Authentication

**How to use:**
1. Login via `/api/mobile/v1/login`
2. Copy the token from the response
3. Click 'Authorize' button above
4. Paste token (without 'Bearer' prefix)
5. Click 'Authorize' to apply

**Test Credentials:**
- Driver: driver@test.com / password123
